raw.description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, field-tested Director of Engineering to lead, scale, and mature our global engineering organization.

In this role, you will be the foundational leader responsible for engineering culture, technical execution, and organizational design. You will manage a talented team of Engineering Managers and Software Engineers, ensuring our platforms remain highly scalable, reliable, and secure.

As a forward-thinking leader, you will also continue to drive the modernization of our development lifecycle. This includes executing a strategic mandate to integrate AI into our development processes, establishing clear baseline metrics to measure and elevate our overall development delivery efficiency.

Core Responsibilities

1. Engineering Leadership & Org Scaling

  • People & Culture: Lead, mentor, and grow a diverse, fully remote engineering team. Build a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and psychological safety.
  • Organizational Design: Structure engineering pods for maximum autonomy and alignment, ensuring clear career ladders and effective succession planning.
  • Product Operating Model Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management leadership to ensure engineering pods operate as empowered, cross-functional teams focused on customer outcomes rather than just output.

2. Technical Strategy & Architecture

  • System Scalability: Oversee the architectural integrity, security, and performance of our high-volume, low-latency ad tech infrastructure.
  • Technical Debt Management: Balance the delivery of new features with the continuous modernization of our codebase, ensuring infrastructure costs are optimized.
  • Risk & Compliance: Maintain robust data privacy, compliance, and security standards across all engineering operations.

3. Delivery Efficiency & Modernization (The AI Mandate)

  • Process Optimization: Establish and monitor core engineering metrics (such as DORA or SPACE frameworks) to identify and eliminate development bottlenecks.
  • AI Integration: Lead the strategic adoption of AI-augmented development tools (e.g., code assistants, automated testing, documentation agents) to eliminate developer toil.
  • Measured Outcomes: Quantify the impact of these modernization initiatives, demonstrating clear improvements in cycle times, deployment frequency, and overall delivery velocity.

Key Success Outcomes

  • Platform Stability & Scale: Maintain high uptime and performance across all product lines while supporting a growing volume of global ad traffic.
  • Delivery Velocity: Increase deployment frequency and reduce cycle times through process optimization and automation.
  • AI Efficiency Implementation: Successfully deploy AI-assisted tooling across the SDLC with a clearly measured, positive impact on developer throughput and code quality.
  • High Team Retention & Engagement: Foster a world-class remote engineering culture with high retention and clear alignment with business goals.

Who You Are

  • The Seasoned Leader: You have 10+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5+ years managing engineering managers in a fast-growing SaaS, Ad Tech, or high-data volume What environment.
  • The Remote Champion: You have a proven track record of managing and scaling highly aligned, culturally diverse, 100% remote engineering teams.
  • Pragmatic Technical Thinker: You possess a deep understanding of modern cloud architecture and distributed systems. You know how to make smart architectural trade-offs that support business growth.
  • Metrics-Driven Operator: You don't guess; you measure. You are deeply familiar with DORA metrics and engineering productivity frameworks.
  • Forward-Looking Innovator: You stay ahead of the curve. You have a practical, realistic understanding of how AI tools can be safely and effectively leveraged to improve engineering workflows.

What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

Assessment Requirement: As part of our hiring process, all applicants who pass the resume screening will be required to complete a TestDome assessment. Only candidates who successfully pass the assessment will be invited to proceed to the Culture Fit Interview.

In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role

We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

raw.description:
Roles & Responsibilities :
We are seeking an experienced AI Expert who can independently design, develop, and deploy Generative AI solutions and embed AI features into Bosch products. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building LLM/SLM-based applications and agentic systems on Azure and/or AWS, from proof-of-concept through production deployment.

This is an end-to-end engineering role. The candidate is expected to own the full lifecycle of Gen AI solutions — problem framing, architecture, model selection, prompt and retrieval design, agentic workflow development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring — while working closely with product teams to translate business needs into reliable, scalable AI capabilities. Experience applying agentic approaches within the software development lifecycle (Agentic SDLC) is strongly valued.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generative AI Solution Development (LLM / SLM):
  • Design, develop, and deploy production-grade Gen AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Small Language Models (SLMs).
  • Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including chunking, embeddings, and vector database integration (e.g., Azure AI Search, ChromaDB, FAISS, Pinecone).
  • Apply advanced prompt engineering, few-shot / structured prompting, function / tool calling, and output validation techniques.
  • Select, fine-tune, and adapt models appropriately, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost across LLM and SLM options.
  • Agentic AI Development:
  • Design and build multi-agent and single-agent systems using agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
  • Implement agent orchestration, tool / function integration, memory, state management, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) based tooling.
  • Apply agentic approaches to the software development lifecycle (Agentic SDLC) requirements, code generation, review, testing, and documentation automation.
  • Build Knowledge Graphs for effective content retrieval.
  • Perform log data analysis and identify anomalies based on log and system-failure data.
  • Optimize agents and model token cost using LiteLLM Proxy and similar tools.
  • Apply domain-based fine-tuning and Small Language Models (SLMs) for code generation.
  • Onboard AI services in the API Marketplace and Gen AI Marketplace.
  • Understand and apply Bosch compliance and processes for AI solution development and deployment.
  • Cloud Engineering & Deployment (Azure / AWS):
  • Develop and deploy Gen AI solutions on Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio, Azure AI Search) and/or AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker).
  • Containerize and deploy services using Docker; implement CI/CD pipelines for reliable, repeatable releases.
  • Apply MLOps / LLMOps practices — versioning, evaluation, observability, cost monitoring, and guardrails — for production stability.
  • Bosch Product Integration:
  • Build and embed Gen AI features into Bosch products and internal platforms, working independently as an AI expert developer.
  • Translate product and business requirements into AI capabilities and prototype rapidly to validate feasibility.
  • Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, data privacy, responsible AI, and compliance.
  • Collaboration, Documentation & Communication:
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams — product, software, QA, and architecture — to integrate AI into the product lifecycle.
  • Maintain clear architecture, design, and operational documentation.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders and present solution options and trade-offs.

Educational qualification:

BE/BTech/MCA/MSc/MTech in CS, IT, AI/ML or related field

Experience :

  • 10 to 15 years of overall software / IT experience, with 5 to 7 years of hands-on Generative AI experience.

Mandatory/requires Skills :

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and deploying Gen AI solutions using LLMs and/or SLMs.
  • Proven experience with at least one major cloud platform — Azure or AWS — for AI workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI framework (LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI).
  • Strong Python programming skills and experience with REST APIs, Git, and Docker.
  • Solid understanding of RAG, Knowledge Graphs, LLM routing, prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently end-to-end.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Skills :
• Experience building Gen AI solutions for Bosch software or mechanical products, or in an enterprise product environment.

  • Experience in full software development and deployment (end-to-end SDLC ownership).
  • Hands-on experience with Agentic SDLC tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, spec-driven / agentic development workflows).
  • Experience with MLOps / LLMOps, model evaluation frameworks, and observability tooling.
  • Experience with fine-tuning, model distillation, or deploying SLMs on constrained / edge environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and responsible / secure AI practices.

Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

This is a full-time, permanent opportunity for candidates based in Italy.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises, including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

About the role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will help build, implement, and deploy agentic platforms within client environments. Your role will focus on building and deploying scalable AI-driven solutions, enabling organisations to operationalise LLM-powered agents across products, processes, and teams. You will work closely with client stakeholders, technical leaders, and delivery teams to build, and roll out agentic capabilities that integrate seamlessly with existing enterprise systems and frameworks.

What we are looking for in this person:

  • Significant experience delivering at a Senior Engineer level. Our Seniors typically have at least 8 years of commercial experience.
  • Experience designing and building agentic platforms using Python and modern AI frameworks.
  • Architect LLM orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and related technologies.
  • Implement multi-agent systems supporting tool use, workflow orchestration, memory, and decision-making.
  • Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines integrating enterprise data sources.
  • Integrate agentic platforms with client systems, including APIs, data platforms, cloud services, and enterprise applications.
  • The ability to configure Kubernetes and deploy workloads.
  • Design deployment architectures across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments.
  • Ability to collaborate efficiently in teams of technical and non-technical individuals.
  • Comfort working in a dynamic environment with evolving objectives and direct iteration with users.
  • Strong consulting experience to plan, execute, and deliver complex client engagements, solving real business problems.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience working with Golang
  • Hands-on experience in the Frontend working with React
  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes

Benefits & Perks:

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - We understand the importance of continuously learning so we offer an allowance you can use to upskill yourself.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances- We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process

    1. Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
      An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.
    2. Technical Assessment (1 hour via Zoom)
      A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your Python expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.
    3. Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)
      A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.


Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence.

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.

  • Als Hüter der Pipelines baust Du Testumgebungen eigenständig auf und integrierst unsere automatisierten Test-Suites nahtlos in die CI CD-Pipelines inklusive macOS-Runnern für ein blitzschnelles Feedback an die Entwicklung.

  • Mit Deinen smarten Skripten wirst Du zum Schutzengel für den Praxisalltag und sicherst selbst die komplexesten End-to-End-Workflows absolut zuverlässig und performant ab.

  • Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit der Entwicklung zusammen und dokumentierst gefundene Bugs so glasklar inklusive Auswirkungseinschätzungen, dass das Dev-Team sofort gezielt handeln kann.

  • Du räumst in unseren Testsystemen auf, verbesserst diese fortlaufend, sagst Flaky-Tests aktiv den Kampf an und betreibst ein strukturiertes sowie vorausschauendes Testdaten-Management.

  • Du genießt die Freiheit, zu 100 % im Homeoffice von Deinem Lieblingsort aus zu arbeiten, sodass Du nicht in Thüringen wohnen musst, um bei uns im Team voll durchzustarten.

  • Du suchst einen langfristigen Heimathafen und bringst Dich idealerweise mit mindestens 32 Stunden pro Woche bei uns ein, wobei einer flexiblen Teilzeitanstellung grundsätzlich nichts im Wege steht.

was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du hast ein Fundament aus einem abgeschlossenen technischen Studium oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation und überzeugst uns vor allem durch Deine fundierte Praxiserfahrung in der Qualitätssicherung.

  • Du bringst gute bis sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in einer für unser Ökosystem relevanten Sprache wie Java, JavaScript, C++, Swift, Dart oder vergleichbaren Sprachen mit.

  • Du hast bereits nachweisbar bewiesen, dass Du komplexe Desktop- oder Client-Server-Systeme automatisieren kannst und kennst die ganz besonderen Herausforderungen der Desktop-Automatisierung.

  • Relationale Datenbanken wie PostgreSQL sind für Dich kein Fremdwort, sondern Dein tägliches Werkzeug, um Testergebnisse auch tief im Backend absolut souverän zu validieren.

  • Moderne Softwareentwicklung ist Deine Welt, Du schreibst sauberen, wartbaren Test-Code, denkst strukturiert in Risiken und bewegst Dich sicher im Umgang mit Git, Tickets und agilen Backlogs.

  • Du kommunizierst klar sowie wertschätzend auf exzellentem deutschem Niveau mit mindestens C1, da Deutsch unsere interne Teamsprache für den komplexen medizinischen Produktkontext und die Dokumentation ist.

  • Deine große Neugier auf die Zukunft sowie Dein Interesse an KI-Tools im Testing oder erste Erfahrungen mit Systemen wie Codex, Claude Cowork, Gemini Spark oder OpenClaw darfst Du bei uns voll ausleben.

  • Eine Zertifizierung nach ISTQB im Bereich Test Automation Engineering oder Foundation Level wäre für uns die absolute Kirsche auf der Sahnehaube, ist aber neben Deiner schnellen Auffassungsgabe kein starres Ausschlusskriterium.

warum wir?

Wir sind ein offenes und ambitioniertes Team von über 750 Mitarbeiter:innen, das Kundenorientierung wirklich lebt und gleichzeitig Spaß hat. Bei uns herrscht auch nach über 10 Jahren eine Startup-Atmosphäre, die neben dem legendären Obstkorb auch vielseitige Perks wie eine steuerfreie Shoppingkarte, Dienstrad-Leasing und Gesundheitskurse (z.B. Yoga, Rückentraining und mental Health) anbietet - sowohl online als auch im Büro.
Je nach Einsatzgebiet (und das sind mindestens 75% aller Unternehmensbereiche) bieten wir all unseren Kollegen flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office an. Wir verstehen uns als eng zusammenhaltendes Team mit Kooperations- statt Wettbewerbs-Atmosphäre. Außerhalb der Arbeit organisieren wir Events wie Beachvolleyball im Sommer, Grillfeste, Kochabende oder Paddeltouren.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:

  • Super Team und flache Hierarchien
  • Job Crafting/individuelle Arbeitsgestaltung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Weiterentwicklung
  • Home Office/Mobiles Arbeiten
  • Team Events
  • Förderung der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Betriebliche Krankenversicherung
  • Dienstradleasing/Jobrad
  • Hardwareleasing
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte
  • Betreuungkostenzuschuss/ Kita-Zuschuss
  • Erholungsbeihilfe
  • Essenszuschuss
  • Fahrtkostenzuschuss
  • Auslandsarbeit

überzeugt? dann bewirb dich jetzt bei uns!

Lade Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung inklusive Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und der relevanten Zeugnisse (Schul-, Ausbildungs-, Uni- und Arbeitszeugnisse) ganz einfach online auf unserer Homepage hoch. Sobald Deine Bewerbung bei uns angekommen bist, erhältst Du eine automatisch Bestätigung per Mail.

Du hast noch Fragen? Dann wende Dich ganz einfach an unsere Personalabteilung. Sabrina, Tom, Aline, Tamar und Laura stehen Dir gerne bei Rückfragen zur Verfügung. Du erreichst sie unter jobs@zollsoft.de. Weitere Informationen findest du auch auf unserer Website.

Role Overview

The National Contract and Compliance Lead is responsible for driving consumables contract strategy, compliance, and growth across the Clinical Measurements portfolio. This role will lead national contract strategy, manage and maximize commercial and operational performance, and ensure contract compliance and recurring revenue.

What You Will Do

Lead national contract strategy for Clinical Measurements consumables, drive revenue growth, own contract funnel creation, monthly forecasting, and demand planning collaboration with supply chain, design and execute high-value consumables contracts, and train and enable sales teams on contract strategy and execution excellence.

Why It Might Be a Fit

The ideal candidate has a minimum of 2 years of experience in contract management, business development, or sales in the healthcare industry, a strong clinical background and understanding of healthcare workflows, and exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Requirements

  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Business / Masters in Business Administrative Marketing, Sales, Economics or equivalent
  • Minimum of 2 years of proven experience in contract management, business development, or sales in the healthcare industry
  • Strong clinical background and understanding of healthcare workflows
  • Strong understanding of clinical measurement products, including ECG, SPO2, NIBP, etCO2, and Batteries
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Proficiency in Salesforce.com (SFDC) or similar CRM tools
  • Strong problem-solving skills to address customer challenges and provide creative solutions

Benefits

  • PTO
  • 401k (up to 7% match)
  • HSA (with company contribution)
  • Stock purchase plan
  • Education reimbursement
